summary: Candidate IDs: bq-source-public-data, bq-opportunity-dual-runtime, bq-data-noaa-gsod, bq-data-citibike. WDI discovery-first; authored nullable metadata recordsets do not establish observation values or current live schema. BQ-R1-2 corrected: bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations and bigquery-public-data.noaa.gsod_stations remain documented alternatives, not live aliases. Citi Bike reserve retains stand-alone distribution/interface/extraction/customer-correlation restrictions; exact commercial intermediary route unresolved. Google materializes query results in destination/temporary tables; useQueryCache=false does not eliminate provider storage; typical ~24h caching is not a deletion SLA. Scope-specific retention authorization, native schema publication, rights, both Go/JavaScript runtimes, auth/project/location/cost and same-job receipts remain pending. Fresh correction review pending. Original 699 candidate and 1177 assertion bytes/IDs/history and scenario order preserved; no queries, rows or activation.
